name: memory-guard
description: Keeps typecheck, build, test and Playwright runs under the memory limit, the tightest cgroup limit on Linux or the machine's memory on Linux, macOS and Windows: runs them with one process, waits for memory or refuses, and reruns a command killed with exit 137.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Check the memory headroom before heavy commands. Off, the mod does nothing and /ram is gone.

margin.title: Margin (%)
margin.description: Share of memory kept free: of each cgroup's memory max, or of the machine's total without a cgroup limit. The high mark counts only for a cgroup with no max.

waitSeconds.title: Wait for memory (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: How long a heavy command waits for memory to free up before it is refused.

reduce.title: Run with one process
reduce.description: When only a single process fits, add --concurrency=1, --workers=1 or --maxWorkers=1.

wait.title: Wait for memory
wait.description: When nothing fits, wait up to waitSeconds for memory to free up. Off, the next step comes at once.

refuse.title: Refuse
refuse.description: When memory does not free up, refuse the command. Off, the command runs as written and may be killed.

retry137.title: Rerun after exit 137
retry137.description: Rerun with one process a command killed with exit 137.

alsoShow.title: Also show in /ram
alsoShow.description: Comma-separated cgroups outside the session's own, like ci.slice, that /ram also shows. They never count in the headroom.
